The '''Fallann hyper-rifle''' was a type of weapon that was favored by many [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]].

==Description==
It shot self-propelled shells that were very accurate over a great distance. It was traditionally used during the [[Midnight Hunter's Duel]], a Rodian custom for when two hunters had a dispute that could not be resolved any other way.

==History==
The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] was known to have possessed a Fallann among her weaponry.
